Splits 50% of Damage into an Explosive Damage portion that deals 30% increased damage and has no damage falloff.

<pve [PVE] 15% Body Shot Damage Increase. Precision Damage Increase varies depending on Precision Multiplier. />

<pvp [PVP] Total damage remains the same. />

text.zh-chs:
将 50% 原伤害量，转换为爆炸伤害，该爆炸伤害提升 30% 伤害量。
引爆延迟和距离相关。

<pve [PVE] 实际增加 15% 命中身体的伤害。 精准伤害的提升量根据武器类型变化。 />

<pvp [PVP] 总伤害量不变（即只有射程上的收益）。 />

#e 被动提升 +5 填装速度。
)

Splits off 50% of the weapon's bodyshot damage into an Explosive Payload that deals 30% increased damage in PvE and isn't affected by damage Falloff.

The remaining Impact damage portion receives an increased Crit Multiplier to compensate for the Payload not benefitting from crits.

<pve/>[PvE] Total damage is increased by 15% of the weapon's bodyshot damage. For crits, the overall increase is roughly equal to 15% divided by the Crit Multiplier.

<pvp/>[PvP] Total damage remains roughly the same but can vary by 1-2% in either direction for crits.

enhanced (
#e Passively grants 5 Reload Speed.
)

Splits off 50% of the weapon's bodyshot damage into an Explosive Payload that detonates on impact. The Payload deals 30% increased damage in PvE and staggers PvE Combatants more.

The remaining Impact damage portion receives an increased Crit Multiplier to compensate for the Payload not benefitting from crits.

<pve/>[PvE] Total damage is increased by 15% of the weapon's bodyshot damage. For crits, the overall increase is roughly equal to 15% divided by the Crit Multiplier.

<pvp/>[PvP] Total damage remains roughly the same but can vary by 1-2% in either direction for crits.

Splits off 50% of the weapon's bodyshot damage into an Explosive Payload that detonates on impact.

The Payload deals 30% increased damage in PvE and staggers PvE Combatants more. <pvp On Hand Cannons, the Payload deals 7% decreased damage in PvP. />

The remaining Impact damage portion receives an increased Crit Multiplier to compensate for the Payload not benefitting from crits.

<pve/>[PvE] Total damage is increased by 15% of the weapon's bodyshot damage. For crits, the overall increase is roughly equal to 15% divided by the Crit Multiplier.

<pvp/>[PvP] Total damage remains roughly the same but can vary by 1-2% in either direction for crits.
